signals.summary: Crusoe raised a $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B valuation to expand AI data centers and modular AI factories.
Crusoe is developing a data center campus in Armstrong County, Texas. The campus is for Google, powered by adjacent West Texas wind, and uses closed-loop liquid cooling.
Crusoe filed for a $4.8B data center campus in Jayton, Texas. Construction is planned to begin at the end of the year.
Crusoe is planning a Phase 3 expansion at its Stargate campus in Abilene, with two new data center buildings.
Crusoe is hiring for senior roles, including Director of Recruiting for Digital Infrastructure and Director of Commercial Operations. The postings suggest the company is scaling its teams.

answer.notes: The funding and Texas campus signals come from several consistent sources. I didn't open the pages, so details rest on search snippets. One search (partnerships) returned an error and was not retried, and a later broader search covered only part of that gap. I found no leadership change, layoff or earnings signals. The leadership search returned only job postings. The Google tie to the Armstrong County campus comes from Crusoe's own newsroom snippet. I didn't verify it elsewhere. The Series F investor list was not captured.
